description.zh: 帮 HR 和用人经理把招聘做得又快又公平：写合规的岗位说明书，制定评分标准批量初筛简历并排序，设计结构化面试题和评估表，汇总多位面试官打分并标出分歧，起草面试邀约和录用、婉拒通知。拒绝歧视性筛选条件。
description.en: Helps HR and hiring managers recruit quickly and fairly: compliant job descriptions, criteria-based resume screening and ranking, structured interview questions and scorecards, multi-interviewer score roll-ups with disagreement flags, and candidate notices. Refuses discriminatory criteria.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要招什么岗位，或把一批简历发给我
welcome_message.en: Tell me the role you're hiring for, or send me a batch of resumes

prompt.zh: 我们要招 ___，汇报给 ___，主要负责 ___，帮我写一份岗位说明书。
prompt.en: We're hiring a ___ reporting to ___, responsible for ___. Write a job description.

prompt.zh: inbound/简历 里有一批 ___ 岗位的简历，按 ___ 这些要求帮我初筛排序。
prompt.en: inbound/简历 has resumes for ___. Screen and rank them against: ___.

prompt.zh: 为 ___ 岗位设计一套结构化面试题，考察 ___，并生成评估表。
prompt.en: Design structured interview questions for ___ covering ___, with a scorecard.

prompt.zh: 面试官填好的评估表在 ___，帮我汇总并看看哪些候选人分歧大。
prompt.en: Completed scorecards are in ___. Roll them up and flag disagreements.

prompt.zh: 检查这份 JD 有没有不合规或歧视性的表述：___
prompt.en: Check this JD for non-compliant or discriminatory wording: ___

description.zh: 邀约 / 录用 / 婉拒

prompt.zh: 给候选人 ___ 写一封 ___（面试邀约/录用/婉拒）通知。
prompt.en: Write a ___ (interview invite/offer/decline) notice for candidate ___.

zh: 每个工作日「09:30」初筛 inbound 中新收到的简历，更新排序表
每周一「10:00」汇总各岗位的简历数、初筛通过数和面试安排
每周五「17:00」汇总本周面试评估表，列出待决策的候选人
面试前一天「16:00」给面试官发送候选人简历要点和面试题
每月 1 日「09:00」统计上月招聘漏斗：投递、初筛、面试、录用
每季度第一天「10:00」检查在招岗位的 JD 是否需要更新
en: Every workday at 09:30, screen new resumes in inbound and update the ranking
Every Monday at 10:00, summarize resumes, passes and interviews per role
Every Friday at 17:00, roll up this week's scorecards and list pending decisions
The day before an interview at 16:00, send interviewers the resume highlights and questions
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, report last month's hiring funnel
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review open JDs for updates
